channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Four Astronauts Finish Eight-Month Voyage and Splash Down Near California
item.description: A crew of four space travelers successfully landed in the Pacific Ocean close to the California shore after spending eight months in orbit. Their spacecraft utilized parachutes to execute the water descent.

item.title: Liverpool and Other Clubs Seek Financial Recovery Amid Manchester City Charges
item.description: Several Premier League teams are reportedly demanding financial compensation following regulatory actions against Manchester City. Liverpool, the upcoming opponent in this ongoing dispute, is among the clubs seeking payouts.

item.title: Anthropic Introduces Complimentary Vulnerability Audits for Open-Source Software
item.description: Artificial intelligence firm Anthropic has introduced the OSS Scanner tool to assist open-source developers in identifying software weaknesses. Participating projects will receive regular, complimentary security evaluations conducted by the company's advanced models.

item.title: GST Council Eliminates Arrest Authority for Tax Officials and Simplifies Refunds
item.description: The GST Council has introduced procedural updates designed to simplify business compliance, registration, and refund procedures. Key modifications include removing arrest powers previously held by tax authorities and reducing operational burdens.

item.title: Goa Authorities Open Unnatural Death Inquiry Following Nana Patekar Passing
item.description: Nana Patekar died Thursday morning at his Goa home following a cardiac arrest, passing away despite resuscitation efforts at Manipal Hospital. Local police have initiated an unnatural death investigation regarding the incident.

item.title: French students reject government offers as school protests continue
item.description: High schoolers and educators across France have maintained blockades and marches to demand better school conditions and increased state funding. Protesters stated that the current government pledges are insufficient and vowed to continue their demonstrations.

item.title: Upcoming South African Test Match Serves as Rematch for World Test Championship
item.description: Two major cricket teams are competing on South African turf for the first time in eight years. This fixture carries significant implications for the qualification standings of the upcoming championship final.

item.title: Paris Law Enforcement Deploy Water Cannons and Tear Gas Against Student Demonstrators
item.description: Security forces in Paris used water cannons and tear gas to disperse students who assembled to call for increased educational funding and additional teaching staff.

item.title: Global Personal Computer Deliveries Drop by 20 Percent in Third Quarter
item.description: Data from IDC indicates that worldwide personal computer shipments declined by 20 percent year-over-year during the third quarter. Analysts note that deteriorating macroeconomic conditions suggest the market outlook may worsen before recovering.

item.title: SpaceX Secures Spectrum Licenses for Starlink Mobile
item.description: SpaceX bought low-band spectrum rights to launch its Starlink Mobile network as a large-scale American cellular provider. The initiative remains contingent on final approval from federal regulators.

item.title: ট্রাম্পের দাবি নভেম্বরের ভোটের আগে ইরানে আক্রমণ নয়
item.description: যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের প্রতিরক্ষা বিভাগ পেন্টাগন ইরানে বড় সামরিক অভিযানের প্রস্তুতি নিতে সামরিক বাহিনীকে নির্দেশ দিয়েছে। তবে ট্রাম্প জানিয়েছেন, নভেম্বরের মধ্যবর্তী নির্বাচনের আগে দেশটিতে কোনো হামলা চালানো হবে না।

item.title: Trump Bestows Top Science Medals on Tech Leaders
item.description: President Trump presented the National Medal of Science, an annual honor recognizing significant achievements by scientists and engineers, to Elon Musk and other technology executives.

item.title: India Considers 30 Percent Cap on Oncology Drug Margins
item.description: New Delhi intends to limit trade margins on oncology medications to lower treatment costs. The policy could drop drug prices by up to seventy percent and create substantial financial relief.

item.title: Research Shows Large Dogs Age Faster Genetically
item.description: An investigation analyzing chemical markers on canine DNA revealed that bigger dogs experience accelerated aging at the epigenetic level compared to smaller breeds.

item.title: Amazon Tablet Compares to High-End Apple iPad Pro
item.description: Amazon's newest tablet matches several features found on premium Apple iPad Pro models while maintaining distinct differences in its design and specifications.

item.title: Musician Zach Bryan Purchases Tennessee Estate for 18 Million
item.description: Singer Zach Bryan acquired an 18.25-million-dollar property spanning 146 acres in Leiper's Fork, Tennessee, earlier this year. The expansive luxury compound also features a built-in recording studio.

item.title: Pentagon Plans Livestream of Fort Hood Shooter Execution
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that the December 3 firing squad execution of convicted Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan will be publicly livestreamed. Hasan was previously convicted of killing 13 individuals and wounding 32.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan activate defense treaty
item.description: To address assaults originating from Yemen's Houthi movement, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan are bringing their mutual defense agreement into effect.

item.title: India discusses military ties with German and Greek officials
item.description: India's defense secretary met with the German ambassador and Greece's deputy minister. The discussions focused on expanding bilateral defense cooperation and industrial partnerships.

item.title: Transfer rumors link Real Madrid and Chelsea to players
item.description: Real Madrid is reportedly pursuing former Manchester United player Scott McTominay and forward Michael Olise. Meanwhile, Chelsea has set its sights on Frenkie de Jong.

item.title: New website replicates Elizabeth Holmes' Theranos desk
item.description: Software engineer Bo Lau launched a site featuring over a thousand trial documents, emails, and texts. The platform simulates exploring the desk of the Theranos founder.

item.title: ডিপি ওয়ার্ল্ড নিউমুরিং টার্মিনালের পরিচালনার দায়িত্ব পেল
item.description: চট্টগ্রাম বন্দর কর্তৃপক্ষের সঙ্গে দুবাই ভিত্তিক প্রতিষ্ঠান ডিপি ওয়ার্ল্ডের একটি চুক্তি স্বাক্ষরিত হয়েছে। গতকাল রাজধানীর আগারগাঁওয়ে ইনভেস্ট বাংলাদেশ কার্যালয়ে এই চুক্তি সম্পন্ন হয়।

item.title: আইজিপির নবীন পুলিশ কর্মকর্তাদের সততার সঙ্গে কাজ করার নির্দেশ
item.description: পুলিশ সদর দপ্তরে ৪৩তম বিসিএস পুলিশ ব্যাচের এএসপিদের উদ্দেশ্যে ব্রিফিং অনুষ্ঠিত হয়। প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে আইজিপি নবীন কর্মকর্তাদের সততা ও নিরপেক্ষতা বজায় রেখে দায়িত্ব পালনের পরামর্শ দেন।

item.title: AMD plans to introduce FSR 4 to portable consoles by late 2026
item.description: AMD consumer chip chief Jack announced plans to bring the FSR 4 framerate technology to handheld gaming devices before the end of 2026.

item.title: Veteran Indian Actor Nana Patekar Passes Away at Age 75
item.description: The prominent Bollywood figure, recognized for his powerful acting style, has died unexpectedly. He established a unique legacy within the Indian film industry throughout his career.

item.title: Indian Air Force marks its 94th founding anniversary
item.description: The Indian Air Force marked its 94th year with celebrations at the Hindon Air Force Station. The event featured aircraft displays and vintage Tiger Moth aerobatics.

item.title: US administration bars Microsoft from international visa scheme
item.description: The American government has prevented Microsoft from participating in a visa initiative designed for recruiting skilled global talent. For a long period, this international program has enabled technology firms in the United States to employ specialized professionals from other countries.

item.title: United States files new torture charges against Nicolas Maduro and his wife
item.description: The former president of Venezuela, Nicolas Maduro, along with his spouse, Cilia Flores, are facing fresh legal accusations from the American government. The newly introduced charges against the couple are linked to claims of torture.

item.title: Anthropic prohibits persistent mistreatment of its artificial intelligence systems
item.description: The technology firm has outlawed continuous and unnecessary harsh or harmful interactions directed at its AI models. Additionally, the organization is implementing stricter regulations regarding elections in preparation for the upcoming midterm voting.

item.title: Violent demonstrations erupt in South Africa following asylum decision
item.description: Public anger surrounding a ruling on asylum has led to clashes in South Africa. In the coastal area of Durban and the Soweto district of Johannesburg, multiple vehicles were set on fire, while enterprises operated by foreign nationals were compelled to close.

item.title: Israel closes United Kingdom consulate located in occupied East Jerusalem
item.description: Following the removal of its diplomatic office by Israeli authorities, the United Kingdom has stated its intention to maintain a diplomatic footprint in occupied East Jerusalem. The decision comes after the Israeli government closed the British consulate in the area.

item.title: Katie Price reacted with anger to assault accusations against former partner, court hears
item.description: During legal proceedings, the mother of the accuser testified that the media personality exhibited significant irritation upon learning of the rape claims. The witness described the celebrity's emotional response when she was first informed about the allegations.

item.title: মাদকবিরোধী অভিযান: উচ্ছেদ করা হলো অর্ধশতক পুরোনো আইজি গেট বস্তি
item.description: আইনশৃঙ্খলা রক্ষাকারী বাহিনী জানিয়েছে, দীর্ঘকাল ধরে আইজি গেট কলোনি বস্তিতে অবৈধ মাদকের কেনাবেচা চলছিল। মাদক কারবারের অন্যতম প্রধান আস্তানা হিসেবে পরিচিত পঞ্চাশ বছরের প্রাচীন এই আবাসন এলাকাটি পুলিশি অভিযানের মাধ্যমে গুঁড়িয়ে দেওয়া হয়েছে।

item.title: Ancient capybara tooth discovery suggests Atacama was not always arid
item.description: Researchers have uncovered a nine-million-year-old tooth from a semi-aquatic rodent in the Atacama Desert. This unexpected find indicates that the region may have previously had a wet environment, as these animals typically require aquatic habitats to survive.

item.title: Telangana activist group detained in Bhopal before Delhi rally
item.description: Police removed four members of the Cockroach Janta Party from a New Delhi-bound train during its stop in Bhopal. The individuals were en route to participate in a planned October 10 demonstration in the capital.

item.title: বিমানবন্দরে বিদেশযাত্রায় বাধা পাওয়া তিন নারীর বক্তব্য
item.description: গত ৮ আগস্ট নেপাল ভ্রমণের উদ্দেশ্যে বৈধ কাগজপত্র ও বিমানের টিকিট নিয়ে বিমানবন্দরে উপস্থিত হন তিন নারী। সে সময় তাদের বিদেশ ভ্রমণে বাধা দেওয়া হয় এবং পরে তারা পুরো ঘটনার বিবরণ তুলে ধরেন।

item.title: বিডিআর সদস্য নজরুল হত্যা ও ময়নাতদন্ত নিয়ে তদন্ত কর্মকর্তার জবানবন্দি
item.description: মামলার তদন্ত কর্মকর্তা রফিকুল ইসলাম আদালতে দেওয়া জবানবন্দিতে জানান, বিডিআর সদস্য নজরুলের ময়নাতদন্তের প্রক্রিয়ায় জিয়াউল প্রভাব খাটিয়েছিলেন। এছাড়া জোরপূর্বক গুম হওয়া বহু ব্যক্তির ভাগ্য এখনো অজানা রয়েছে বলে তিনি উল্লেখ করেন।

item.title: Maresca tells Man City players to stay focused and positive
item.description: As reported by BBC Sport, Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca wants his squad to focus and be positive after the club were found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules. Key points: Maresca, Man City, Manchester City, Enzo Maresca.

item.title: Activist groups report detentions prior to October 10 protest
item.description: Left-leaning organizations and the CJP reported that multiple supporters have been taken into custody ahead of the October 10 demonstration. Ashutosh Ranka stated that CJP leader Deepak Baliyan was detained in Rajasthan.

item.title: US and European officials to review Ukraine peace proposals in Miami
item.description: Representatives of Donald Trump, along with European and Ukrainian delegates, are scheduled to meet in Miami on Friday. According to US sources, the participants will review fresh strategies aimed at resolving the conflict in Ukraine.

item.title: Mexican court nears verdict in murder trial of surfers
item.description: A Mexican judge is set to announce a verdict on Thursday regarding three men accused of murdering two Australian brothers and their American friend. The parents of the victims are scheduled to speak in court prior to the ruling.

item.title: Allahabad HC questions term Andolanjivi in NSA journalist case
item.description: While reviewing the NSA detention case of journalist Satyam Verma, the Allahabad High Court questioned the meaning of the word 'Andolanjivi'. The bench also raised concerns about how this expression was included in official paperwork.

item.title: Apple to reportedly launch touchscreen MacBook in late October
item.description: Reports indicate Apple plans to unveil its initial touchscreen MacBook Pro alongside a revised iPad Mini near October 27. This follows a separate rumored product announcement previously scheduled by the company.

item.title: Nana Patekar Cremated in Pune Following Cardiac Arrest
item.description: Actor Nana Patekar received a state funeral in Pune following his death from a cardiac arrest. Numerous supporters and cinema personalities gathered for the evening service, which took place on the day he passed away.

item.title: Yemen Conflict Displaces Over 200000 People
item.description: The United Nations reports that ongoing armed conflict has forced more than 200,000 individuals from their homes within a five-week period. This escalation deepens the severe humanitarian emergency in Yemen.

item.title: Court Restores Passport for Medical Student in Iran
item.description: The Jammu and Kashmir High Court ordered the reinstatement of a passport belonging to Ibra Khan, an MBBS student at Tehran University. Her travel document had been seized because of her father's prior legal matter, despite her being midway through her studies.

item.title: Advocacy Group Labels Teen ChatGPT Unsafe
item.description: Following thorough evaluations, Common Sense Media concluded that ChatGPT for Teens presents an unacceptable hazard. The organization stated the artificial intelligence tool did not meet standards across five essential categories.

item.title: Seychelles island census reveals record-breaking population of 180,000 giant tortoises
item.description: A new survey indicates that the giant tortoise population on a Seychelles island has reached its highest recorded level. Experts highlight this growth as a major success for conservation efforts within the Indian Ocean region.

item.title: Arkansas Court Awards Family $12000 in Property Dispute
item.description: The Arkansas Court of Appeals ruled in favor of the Bowlin family, granting them $12,000 after neighbors tore down a long-standing property boundary fence and trees. The barrier had marked the property line since 1967.

item.title: Dismissed OpenAI Safety Staff Reject Misconduct Allegations
item.description: Three former OpenAI safety employees published an open letter challenging accusations of leaking confidential data. They cautioned that their terminations negatively impact the artificial intelligence safety environment at the firm.

item.title: Ceferin to stand for fourth term as Uefa president
item.description: As reported by BBC Sport, Uefa president Aleksander Ceferin is set to stand for a fourth term, reversing a previous decision to stand down. Key points: Ceferin, Uefa, Aleksander Ceferin, stand.

item.title: Palestinian Farmers Confront Violence During Olive Harvest
item.description: Palestinian agricultural workers are encountering increasing aggression as Israeli settlers gather olives from local land. These incidents threaten generational harvesting customs in the region.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Video Game Adapting into Feature Film
item.description: CD Projekt Red will produce a cinematic adaptation of Cyberpunk 2077 in partnership with Paramount Pictures. The project marks the newest video game transition to the big screen.

item.title: রাজধানীতে সড়ক দুর্ঘটনায় মায়ের মৃত্যু
item.description: চিকিৎসকের কাছে নেওয়ার পথে ঢাকায় সড়ক দুর্ঘটনায় এক নারী নিহত হয়েছেন। এছাড়া গত বৃহস্পতিবার যাত্রাবাড়ীতে বাস ও ট্রাকের সংঘর্ষে সতেরো বছর বয়সী এক কিশোর প্রাণ হারায়।

item.title: আফগানিস্তানে পোশাকবিধি ভঙ্গের দায়ে নারীদের আটক করা হচ্ছে: জাতিসংঘ
item.description: পোশাকবিধি অমান্য করা এবং পুরুষ অভিভাবক ছাড়া জনসমক্ষে আসার অভিযোগে সম্প্রতি আফগান নারীদের আটক করছে তালেবান প্রশাসন। গত কয়েক মাসে বহু নারীকে এভাবে হেফাজতে নেওয়া হয়েছে।

item.title: মানুষ বনাম রোবট লড়াই বন্ধের চেষ্টা ক্যালিফোর্নিয়ায়
item.description: গত ১৮ সেপ্টেম্বর মানব ও রোবটের মধ্যকার একটি লড়াই আয়োজনের পর সংশ্লিষ্ট স্টার্টআপটিকে একটি বন্ধের নোটিশ পাঠিয়েছে ক্যালিফোর্নিয়া স্টেট অ্যাথলেটিক কমিশন।

item.title: উপনির্বাচনের ভোটগণনা ও ফলাফল দেখার নির্দেশিকা
item.description: আজ সকাল আটটা থেকে পাঁচটি বিধানসভা কেন্দ্র ও নাগাঁও লোকসভা আসনের ভোটগণনা শুরু হয়েছে এবং সারাদিন ধরে ফলাফল প্রকাশিত হবে। ভারতের নির্বাচন কমিশনের ওয়েবসাইটে এসব আপডেট পাওয়া যাবে।

item.title: রাষ্ট্র পুনর্গঠনে আলেমদের যুক্ত করার আহ্বান চরমোনাই পীরের
item.description: বৃহস্পতিবার রাজধানীর ফার্মগেটে আয়োজিত এক সম্মেলনে চরমোনাই পীর সৈয়দ মুহাম্মাদ রেজাউল করীম রাষ্ট্র সংস্কারের কাজে আলেম সমাজকে সম্পৃক্ত করার ওপর গুরুত্বারোপ করেন।

item.title: Madrid protest planned following death of evicted 87-year-old resident
item.description: A large demonstration is scheduled in central Madrid on Thursday evening to honor María del Carmen Abascal. The 87-year-old's dispute with an investment firm over rent and her subsequent eviction sparked countrywide protests regarding housing issues.

item.title: ফিলিস্তিনিদের জলপাই সংগ্রহে বসতি স্থাপনকারীদের হামলা
item.description: দখলকৃত পশ্চিম তীরে ফিলিস্তিনিদের জলপাই গাছ ধ্বংসের মতো নানাবিধ হামলা চালিয়ে আসছে ইসরায়েলি বসতি স্থাপনকারীরা।
